3a1e8525f083a701.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفاعلية العلاج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه لدراسة الحالة بدقة. إجراء الفحص السريري اللازم وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية والصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير النتائج والتقارير الطبية لتشخيص الحالة المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المطبقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية في صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

3ae1e760e6aec9f0.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبو عريش، جازان. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان أفضل رعاية للمرضى. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة وهي بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية في مجال التخصص. وضع الخطط العلاجية المناسبة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية الخطة العلاجية المتبعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى وحفظها بشكل دقيق ومنظم. إجراءات الفحص والتشخيص أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه لفهم التاريخ الصحي. إجراء الفحص السريري الدقيق لتقييم الحالة الصحية. طلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير بدقة لتشخيص الحالة المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة جامعية في الطب مع تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة أبو عريش بمنطقة جازان. يعمل الطبيب الاخصائي ضمن فريق طبي متخصص، مما يوفر بيئة داعمة للنمو المهني وتبادل الخبرات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

3a2000610a108c0c.description: About ALPLA Group ALPLA Group is seeking a Manufacturing Manager to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for a professional with 5-10 years of experience in manufacturing operations. Role Overview The Manufacturing Manager will be responsible for overseeing daily production and maintenance activities, ensuring operational efficiency, and aligning processes with global standards. This role involves managing personnel, optimizing production metrics, and implementing maintenance procedures to support overall plant profitability. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily production plans, schedule personnel, and ensure target output is met. Optimize cycle times, material usage, and implement waste reduction strategies. Implement preventive maintenance procedures, track downtimes, and manage spare parts. Safeguard tools and align operations with established global standards. Conduct 5S assessments, GMP audits, risk evaluations, and Gemba walks to enforce safety standards and company policies. Define department KPIs, manage energy and consumption tracking, and analyze operational issues. Submit monthly reports to management regarding operational performance. Identify staff training needs, ensure effective cross-departmental communication, and lead regular operational synchronization meetings. Assist the Head of Operations in budget preparation and support overall plant efficiency and profitability initiatives. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a manufacturing management role. Work Environment and Benefits The successful candidate will work within a modern, international, and stable company that is continuously growing. This role offers the opportunity to be part of a dynamic team and to work independently within a defined area of responsibilities.

3a27a9ee18f61c76.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن أمين مستودع فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في رابغ، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى إدارة المخزون بكفاءة، بدءاً من استلام المواد وفحصها وتخزينها، وصولاً إلى صرفها، مع الحفاظ على سجلات دقيقة لجميع العمليات. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع أقسام المشتريات والإنتاج لضمان توفر المواد ومنع النقص، مما يساهم في كفاءة وسلامة عمليات المستودع بشكل عام. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديث سجلات المخزون ومتابعة مستويات المواد بشكل دوري، وتنفيذ عمليات الجرد لضمان دقة البيانات. فحص المواد الواردة بدقة والتحقق من مطابقتها للمواصفات، ثم تخزينها بأمان وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. صرف المواد للفرق المعنية عند الطلب، وتوثيق جميع حركات الصرف بشكل دقيق. تحديث أنظمة المخزون وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير اللازمة حول حركة المواد ومستوياتها. الالتزام بجميع متطلبات السلامة والجودة المعمول بها في المستودع لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وفعالة. التنسيق الفعال مع أقسام المشتريات والخدمات اللوجستية والإنتاج لمنع أي نقص في المواد وضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المستودعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على إدارة المخزون وتحديث السجلات بدقة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والجودة في بيئة المستودعات. بيئة العمل يعمل أمين المستودع الفني بدوام كامل في مدينة رابغ بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع فرق العمل المختلفة داخل الشركة لضمان كفاءة العمليات اللوجستية. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

3a95622b67aef44a.description: About Air Products Qudra and BHIG Air Products Qudra is a company that focuses on innovation and operational excellence. The Blue Hydrogen Industrial Gases (BHIG) is a regional development and investment joint venture between Saudi Aramco and Air Products Qudra. BHIG is dedicated to supporting clean energy goals through low-carbon hydrogen production and driving industrial innovation across Saudi Arabia and the region. Role Overview: HYCO Training Specialist The HYCO Training Specialist is responsible for developing, delivering, and managing comprehensive training programs. This role aims to cultivate a highly skilled and knowledgeable workforce to ensure the safe, efficient, and reliable operation and maintenance of the Hydrogen production plant in Al Jubail. The specialist will report to the training lead and manage the technical training program for Operations & Maintenance staff at the Jubail HYCO (Steam Methane Reformer) Facility, including ancillary equipment such as cooling water and boiler feed water systems. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Provide and maintain a safe work environment, demonstrating leadership in company and industry safe work processes. Ensure proper implementation and documentation of safety-related activities. Offer direction and guidance based on technical feedback from Engineering and Maintenance for troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and testing. Support and guide Operations & Maintenance teams during facility commissioning and startup. Maintain accurate document control and monitor training initiatives, documenting activities for each Operations staff member. Develop training curricula with periodic testing for Operations & Maintenance staff to track progression, identify gaps, and ensure timely operational readiness. Develop advanced training material for senior operators, focusing on process safety and efficiency. Ensure the safety of all operations personnel by utilizing the BHIG Basic Safety Practice program (*, Safety Work Permits, LOTO, Confined Space). Train Operations & Maintenance personnel, with HSSE team assistance, in planning, organizing, auditing, and follow-up to build BHIG's safety culture. Establish and deliver a training program for HYCO Operations & Maintenance teams while supporting commissioning. Ensure BHIG standards and global best practices for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality, and customer service are integrated into the training program. Guide HYCO operating & maintenance teams through on-the-job training to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant operation with contractual requirements. Support and maintain close working relationships with engineering and maintenance personnel to continuously monitor and enhance training packages. Provide operations support and participate in investigations and Root Cause Analysis to identify and implement sustainable corrective actions. Manage operations procedures and train on new procedures developed through the Management of Change Process. Onboard new Operators and Maintenance personnel, leading them through the training program, monitoring performance, and addressing gaps. Conduct regular SWIM’s audits and provide action plans to close identified gaps. Act as a liaison with local technical schools, assisting in developing programs for BHIG-sponsored students in HYCO technology. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience is required. Demonstrated expertise in developing and delivering technical training programs, particularly in industrial plant operations. Strong understanding of Hydrogen production plant operations, including Steam Methane Reformers (HYCO) and ancillary systems. Proficiency in safety protocols and practices within an industrial environment. Work Environment The HYCO Training Specialist will be part of the operating staff and will support operations as a day-to-day function. The role is based in Al Jubail and is a full-time position.

3ac0c378333805d6.description: About Basamh Group Basamh Group is a consumer-centric organization with over 75 years of experience, serving the MEA region. The group's operations include Basamh Trading Company (BTC) for retail distribution, Specialized Food Services (SFS) for HORECA, GoodyCo for marketing and brand building, and Thokoman Foods for manufacturing. Guided by values of true ownership, passion to grow, transparency, and family spirit, Basamh Group focuses on fostering long-term partnerships and contributing to community upliftment. The Role: Administrative Assistant Basamh Group is seeking an Administrative Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organizational support to the Managing Director and the executive team. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and is crucial for ensuring smooth coordination, time efficiency, and effective communication among stakeholders. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Manage the Managing Director's calendar, appointments, and scheduling, including prioritizing meetings, travel, and events. Coordinate schedules for other executive leaders to ensure alignment for cross-functional meetings and engagements. Organize and prepare materials for internal and external meetings, including agendas, presentations, minutes, and follow-ups. Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external communications directed to the Managing Director, managing correspondence, emails, and calls with discretion. Handle complex travel arrangements, including flight bookings, accommodations, visa processing, and detailed itineraries for the Managing Director and occasionally for other executives. Support event planning and logistics for executive meetings, board sessions, and leadership offsites. Coordinate with various departments and executive assistants across the company to ensure smooth operations and communication flow. Perform general administrative tasks such as document archiving, data entry, supplies coordination, and ad-hoc requests. Take minutes of meetings, including Lead Team Meetings and Business Reviews, and distribute them subsequently. Required Experience 0-1 years of experience in an administrative or similar support role. Work Environment and Culture Basamh Group is committed to fostering a culture of growth and innovation. The company supports continuous professional development through hands-on learning, comprehensive online resources, interactive training, and personalized coaching. The work environment is guided by a family spirit, ensuring that every individual feels valued, supported, and empowered to contribute to collective success and find fulfillment within the Basamh Group family.

3adf5448c84b1cd1.description: About the Internship TechnipFMC is offering a Tool Management & Operational Excellence Internship in Dhahran, Eastern Province. This internship is designed for individuals seeking 0-1 years of experience and is structured as a COOP placement. The role focuses on supporting the development and implementation of effective management systems for various tools and coordinating continuous improvement initiatives. Internship Purpose The primary purpose of this internship is to support the establishment of an effective management system for CNC cutting tools, general tools, and fixtures. This involves consumption analysis, inventory visibility, traceability, and replenishment controls. Additionally, the intern will coordinate 5S, Kaizen, and other continuous improvement activities, including pull systems, standard work, and A3 problem-solving, under the guidance of the Operations Support and Operational Excellence teams. Key Responsibilities Study current practices for managing CNC cutting tools, general tools, and fixtures; identify gaps and recommend practical improvements. Analyze cutting-tool consumption, cost, and tool-life data to identify opportunities for reducing unnecessary consumption. Utilize consumption trends, production requirements, stock levels, and supplier lead times to support demand forecasting and recommend order quantities and timing. Support a simple tool-tracking system and pilot agreed improvements under supervision; document results and provide recommendations at the end of the six-month placement. Support 5S audits and Kaizen activities in assigned areas, following up on agreed improvement actions with area owners. Assist selected pull-system and A3 projects through data collection, gap analysis, and progress tracking under guidance. Required Qualifications and Experience Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline, and eligible for a university COOP placement. Basic academic understanding of manufacturing processes, CNC cutting tools, tools and fixtures, inventory control, and Lean principles. No prior professional experience is required. Academic projects or exposure to manufacturing, data analysis, inventory management, or continuous improvement are advantageous. Required Skills and Knowledge Clear communication, teamwork, attention to detail, initiative, and willingness to learn. Ability to coordinate follow-ups respectfully with cross-functional teams. Basic awareness of 5S, Kaizen, pull systems/Kanban, A3 problem solving, and standard work. Willingness to develop practical knowledge of tool traceability, consumption monitoring, and site HSE and quality requirements.

3a0eac6be1a20a90.description: About Carrier (KSA) Carrier is a global provider of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), refrigeration, fire, security, and cold chain solutions. We are seeking a Senior Sales Engineer to join our team in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, specifically in Dammam or Jeddah. This is a permanent position requiring 2-5 years of experience. Role Overview The Senior Sales Engineer will be responsible for achieving business targets and enhancing profitability within the HVAC projects sector. This role involves building a robust sales pipeline and focusing on strategic accounts to secure large-scale projects. Key Responsibilities Acquire new customers and maintain relationships with existing clients. Prepare and submit quotes, then follow up to convert them into orders. Conduct market surveys to identify and generate new leads. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering is required. 3-5 years of experience in HVAC projects sales within KSA. Demonstrated HVAC sales experience specifically in the KSA Eastern Region. Proven track record of sales achievement and a strong market network. Excellent communication skills. Knowledge of or contacts within the oil and gas sector is an advantage. Benefits and Professional Development Carrier offers professional development opportunities within an international working environment. The compensation package includes a competitive salary and exceptional benefits, along with access to an Employee Assistance Program to support personal goals.

3a220a95a373ff1c.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare (JHAH) is seeking a Cancer Care Nurse 3 to provide advanced-level nursing care within an assigned unit in Dhahran. This full-time role focuses on maintaining high standards of patient care, resolving complex clinical issues, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to ensure efficient care delivery. Strategic Contributions The Cancer Care Nurse 3 contributes to strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing nursing practices and operational efficiency. This involves active participation in developing protocols to improve patient safety and supporting the empowerment of nurses through the JHAH nursing Professional Practice Model. Contribute to strategic initiatives for improving nursing practices within the assigned unit. Participate in developing protocols and processes to enhance patient safety and operational efficiency. Support high staff engagement and patient experience. Work to achieve and sustain high quality of care and patient safety standards. Support the empowerment of nurses through the JHAH nursing Professional Practice Model. Key Responsibilities This role involves delivering high-quality nursing care, particularly for complex cases, and managing workflow to ensure proper resource utilization. The nurse will also mentor junior staff and ensure adherence to clinical protocols. Deliver high-quality nursing care services, with a focus on complex cases. Assist in managing workflow, ensuring proper resource utilization, and providing mentorship to junior nurses. Ensure adherence to clinical protocols and participate in the evaluation of patient outcomes. Achieve and/or maintain the mandated activities for level 3, requiring a minimum of 20 points in at least four categories within each 12-month cycle as outlined in the Clinical Advancement Program. Utilize the nursing process to assess, plan, implement, evaluate, and document patient care from admission through discharge, specific to the patient's age. Provide nursing care and patient/family education consistent with the plan of care and patient needs, respecting privacy, dignity, personal preference, and culture. Precept new hires and trainees during their probation training period and provide recommendations regarding their progress and training needs. Respond promptly and effectively to emergency and lifesaving situations using clinical skills, critical thinking, and evidence-based practices. Perform a wide range of nursing procedures with attention to accuracy, patient safety, and comfort, maintaining a safe and organized environment. Manage patients requiring invasive and non-invasive hemodynamic monitoring, including close monitoring and assessments of treatment and care coordination. Experience Requirements Candidates for this position should possess 4 years of relevant experience in nursing, demonstrating proficiency in advanced patient care and clinical problem-solving.

3a52e8fe0cbb93e1.job_title: Oracle FLEXCUBE Technical Support Consultant (L /L )_Al Kobar/KSA_WFO
3a52e8fe0cbb93e1.description: About BTranz BTranz Software Solutions is an ERP and Mobile Application Development company. The company provides a range of services including Oracle ERP, VAT, and Cloud Services, alongside mobile application development. With a presence in multiple countries, BTranz serves customers globally, with a significant client base in the UAE and East African countries. The company is professionally managed by experienced technocrats with over a decade of industry experience. The Role: Data Stream Support Consultant BTranz is seeking a Data Stream Support Consultant to join its team in Al Khobar. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. The role focuses on supporting Oracle FLEXCUBE and Oracle Banking projects, leveraging strong technical and client-facing skills. Key Responsibilities Providing support for Oracle FLEXCUBE * Core environments. Engaging in Oracle Banking and Core Banking projects. Contributing to migration, integration, or technical development efforts based on project requirements. Troubleshooting technical issues and providing solutions. Proficiency in Oracle PL/SQL and Java programming languages. Experience in Oracle Banking or Core Banking projects. Relevant experience in migration, integration, or technical development. Strong troubleshooting and client-facing skills. Experience Level This position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of relevant experience in the specified technologies and banking domains. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time role in Al Khobar. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3a5ea28e088d20f6.description: About the Role First Gulf Company is seeking a Fleet Administrator to join its Supply Chain Division in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for ensuring the efficient, compliant, and cost-effective management of the company's fleet operations. The successful candidate will oversee various administrative and operational aspects related to the fleet. Role Overview The Fleet Administrator will be responsible for the comprehensive management of the company's vehicle fleet. This includes coordinating maintenance, managing leasing and insurance, and tracking expenses to ensure smooth and compliant operations. The role requires a proactive approach to fleet administration and a commitment to maintaining detailed records. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily fleet operations and administrative tasks. Coordinate vehicle servicing, maintenance, and workshop schedules. Manage leasing contracts, procurement requests, and insurance renewals. Monitor fuel usage and expenses, and prepare accurate reports. Handle accident reporting and ensure compliance with company policies. Maintain updated fleet documentation and records. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience in fleet administration or a related field. A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience is required. Strong organizational and administrative skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Fleet Administrator will work within the Supply Chain Division, collaborating with various departments to ensure seamless fleet operations. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3a8b797a17f9a8f8.job_title: Step Up Your Pastry Career: Junior Pastry Sous Chef
3a8b797a17f9a8f8.description: About the Opportunity The Career Nest is partnering with an upscale dining establishment in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, known for its focus on quality food and hospitality. This full-time role is for a Junior Pastry Sous Chef to contribute to the pastry section, maintaining high standards and supporting the team. Role Overview As a Junior Pastry Sous Chef, you will work under the Head Pastry Chef, taking responsibility for daily pastry production. This includes items from viennoiserie to plated desserts, ensuring consistent quality. The role also involves developing junior team members and leading the section when required. Key Responsibilities Execute classic and contemporary pastry techniques with precision and attention to presentation. Support the motivation and development of the pastry team, maintain discipline during busy periods, and lead the section in the Head Pastry Chef's absence. Plan daily production, monitor shelf life, adhere to FIFO and labeling standards, and manage freezing and defrosting procedures. Ensure all pastry items meet strict standards for taste, texture, and visual appeal, while maintaining a clean and compliant workspace. Monitor stock levels, manage portion controls, and minimize waste to maintain quality and control food costs. Qualifications and Experience 3 to 5 years of dedicated pastry experience, with 2 to 3 years as a Chef de Partie Pastry or senior pastry cook in a fine dining or upscale restaurant. Strong practical knowledge of viennoiserie, doughs, creams, chocolate work, and fillings. Understanding of shelf life, storage protocols, and allergen controls. Demonstrated precision, creativity, and a focus on consistency and cost awareness. Compensation The salary for this position is 7,000 SAR per month. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position located in Al Khobar, Eastern Province.

3ab24a44bfce43be.job_title: Junior Sous Chef Fast Paced Upscale Neighbourhood Restaurant
3ab24a44bfce43be.description: About the Opportunity The Career Nest is partnering with a highly regarded, upscale casual dining restaurant in Al Khobar, Eastern Province. This establishment is known for its exceptional food and warm hospitality, focusing on executing simple dishes beautifully within a fast-paced environment. We are seeking a driven culinary professional to join the team. The Role of Junior Sous Chef As a Junior Sous Chef, you will provide essential support to the Sous Chef and Head Chef in the daily management of kitchen operations. This role requires a professional who can serve as both a technical anchor and an emerging leader, overseeing food preparation, maintaining rigorous standards, and stepping in to manage the line during busy services. This is a full-time position with a salary of 8,000 SAR monthly. Key Responsibilities Oversee food preparation, cooking, and plating to ensure precision, consistency, and quality across all sections during every service. Motivate, train, and support the kitchen brigade, leading by example and taking command of kitchen operations when necessary. Strictly enforce food safety and hygiene protocols across all stations, ensuring a compliant and spotless working environment. Manage inventory control, stock rotation, and kitchen flow, adapting seamlessly to the shifting demands of busy services. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a culinary role, preferably within an upscale or fast-paced restaurant environment. Demonstrated technical excellence in food preparation and cooking. Proven ability to lead and mentor a kitchen team. Strong understanding and adherence to food safety and hygiene standards. Excellent organizational skills and adaptability to dynamic kitchen demands. Work Environment This role is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, within a casual neighbourhood dining destination that operates at an upscale level. The kitchen environment is fast-paced and requires a professional who thrives in a dynamic setting, contributing to a team focused on high standards and warm hospitality. Application Process Candidates who meet the outlined qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time Junior Sous Chef position.

3a266fc246b756f2.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Front of House (Reporting to the Restaurant Manager) Compensation: 6,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are exclusively partnering with an exquisite, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this concept is looking for a polished Receptionist to act as the ultimate gatekeeper of the guest experience. The Role As the first point of contact, you are the face of the restaurant. You will manage reservations, warmly welcome and farewell guests, and ensure the flow of the dining room feels effortless from the moment the doors open. By seamlessly optimizing the seating plan, you will play a direct role in the restaurant's daily performance and atmosphere. Your Profile & Experience Experience: No prior experience is required—your personality, warmth, and natural charm matter most. Familiarity with hospitality reservation systems is a plus. Traits: Elegant, poised, and highly organized. You maintain composure and balance even when the room is full and the pace is fast. Language: English fluency (written and spoken) is mandatory. Additional language skills such as Arabic or French are a genuine advantage. Core Responsibilities Reservation Flow: Manage the waitlist, bookings, walk-ins, and seating arrangements with ease, ensuring every guest feels expected and the room's momentum stays consistent. Proactive Communication: Deliver warm in-person interactions and clear, professional phone etiquette. You anticipate needs naturally, such as taking initial drink orders while guiding guests to their tables. Organization & Profiling: Keep the guest list accurate, actively build detailed guest profiles, and maintain an immaculate reception area at all times.

3a82f4ee9353b566.description: Nama Partners is a strategic consulting firm based in Saudi Arabia, working with family groups, holding companies, listed companies, banks, insurance firms, government entities, and industrial establishments. About the Job You will work with the consulting team to transform analytical and strategic material into documents that can be easily read by a board of directors or an executive committee. Tasks and Responsibilities Designing presentations and reports submitted to clients, relying on company templates while developing them when necessary. Required Qualifications Basic knowledge of design software, primarily Adobe InDesign and Illustrator, along with PowerPoint, and general familiarity with other Adobe programs. Initial experience in design from any source: internship, academic project, side work, or a previous assignment. Clear ability to communicate in Arabic, both written and spoken, because most of the material you will work on is in Arabic. Organization in managing files and deadlines, as the work involves multiple assignments simultaneously. Precision in reviewing before delivery, and attention to detail regarding small errors in numbers and headings. Willingness to learn from team feedback and adjust your style accordingly. Additional Preferred Qualifications It is helpful if you have knowledge of corporate document design principles, experience in converting Excel data into charts, knowledge of interface design software, or the ability to read English for references and files coming from abroad. Any previous work in a consulting firm, financial institution, or government entity adds weight to your profile, as does having a portfolio of work to review. What We Offer This is a permanent, full-time position. The work is remote, with the company headquarters in Riyadh, offering flexibility in organizing your day without the need to be present at an office. You will work on real material pertaining to institutional clients established in the Kingdom, and your work will be reviewed against clear professional standards, with direct feedback from the team on every file. Coordination with the author of the material and the partner in charge of the assignment is part of the daily routine, and feedback is concise and direct. How We Work Together The decision in our visual work rests with the person who will stand before the document and explain it. We discuss the file openly and decide which elements deserve to be the most prominent, then we build upon that. Whoever handles the file is responsible for its final appearance and for sending it at the agreed-upon time, and they can object to the layout of a page or a graphic that does not convey a clear message. We do not rely on an external design agency for our daily work, so the full context remains with you: who the reader is, what the proposed decision is, and what the takeaway should be. Anyone who gets used to asking before designing, and to keeping their files organized and properly named, will find this role suitable for their professional start.

Legal Cases and Claims Follow up on legal cases, disputes, and claims involving the company. Coordinate with external lawyers, legal consultants, and relevant authorities. Prepare and organize documents related to employment contracts, warnings, investigations, and terminations. Follow up on labor complaints and claims. Maintain accurate and updated legal records. Ensure confidentiality of all company legal information. Complete assigned legal tasks within the required deadlines. Completion of assigned tasks within agreed timelines. Note: The Legal Coordinator performs administrative and legal coordination duties. 3a4839a4c0f39446.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ أنشطة الشراء اليومية لضمان توفير المواد وقطع الغيار والمعدات والمستهلكات والخدمات في الوقت المناسب، وذلك بما يتماشى مع السياسات والصلاحيات المعتمدة في الشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية معالجة طلبات الشراء المعتمدة بكفاءة ودقة. طلب عروض الأسعار من الموردين ومقارنة الجوانب المختلفة مثل السعر والمواصفات والجودة وشروط التسليم والسداد. إعداد أوامر الشراء واستكمال الموافقات اللازمة قبل إصدارها. متابعة الموردين ومواعيد التسليم والمتطلبات المعلقة لضمان الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية. التنسيق الفعال مع أقسام الإنتاج والصيانة والعمليات والمستودع والمالية لضمان سلاسة العمليات. معالجة أي تأخير أو نقص أو فروقات في الأسعار أو مشكلات تتعلق بالتوريد. البحث عن موردين وبدائل مناسبة عند الحاجة لضمان استمرارية الإمداد. حفظ وتوثيق جميع الطلبات والعروض والأوامر ومستندات التسليم والمراسلات المتعلقة بالمشتريات. التحقق من فواتير الموردين ومستنداتها بالتنسيق مع القسم المالي. إعداد تقارير دورية عن المشتريات والتوريدات المعلقة وتصعيد المشكلات عند الضرورة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المشتريات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مقارنة عروض الموردين وتقييمها بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتنسيق مع الأقسام الداخلية والموردين الخارجيين. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

3ac7f63521a68793.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاختيار الأول للملاعب الرياضية عن مدير عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى هذا الدور قيادة وتوجيه كافة عمليات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية، مع الإشراف الشامل على دورات عمل الموظفين من الاستقطاب والتوظيف وحتى إدارة العلاقات والمزايا. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان أعلى مستويات الكفاءة التشغيلية والاستقرار التنظيمي. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في وضع الأهداف الاستراتيجية لقطاع الموارد البشرية وتطوير مقاييس الأداء. الإشراف على صياغة وتنفيذ خطط وبرامج الاستقطاب والتوظيف، ومتابعة عمليات التدريب وإدارة الأداء. قيادة عملية رسم وتحسين الإجراءات الداخلية لسياسات الموارد البشرية وتحديثها لضمان تطبيقها بكفاءة. تحديد وتوفير المتطلبات التشغيلية لإدارة الموارد البشرية من ميزانيات وكوادر بشرية وأنظمة تقنية. الإشراف على إدارة مستحقات الموظفين، والإجازات، وعلاقات العمل، وتطبيق الأنظمة لضمان الامتثال. إعداد التقارير الشاملة والمؤشرات الرئيسية لعمليات الموارد البشرية وتقديم التوصيات للإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم شامل لدورات حياة الموظفين وسياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية. القدرة على القيادة والتوجيه المباشر للفرق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل مدير عمليات الموارد البشرية ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى مستويات الكفاءة التشغيلية والاستقرار التنظيمي. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

3adfe13aec408b3a.description: We are one of the leading companies in the medical equipment, devices, and supplies industry in the GCC region, providing high-quality solutions and services to healthcare providers. We deliver a comprehensive portfolio of healthcare solutions, including laboratory solutions. We are launching a new joint project with a company that operates within the energy, geoscience, petroleum laboratory, and geological services industry. The organization supports exploration and subsurface evaluation through specialized laboratory services, geological analysis, digital imaging, petrography, and data-quality management. This project is based at a major exploration core laboratory in the Eastern area and involves the automated scanning, quality control, and analysis of petrographic thin-section slides. The work combines geology, laboratory operations, petrographic analysis, advanced imaging technology, quality assurance, and operational data management to support accurate geological interpretation and exploration-related decision-making. About the Opportunity: We are seeking two Geological Slide Scanning Technicians to support the daily operation of automated geological slide-scanning equipment. The successful candidates will be responsible for the careful handling, preparation, tracking, scanning, inspection, and quality control of petrographic thin-section slides. Key Responsibilities: Operate automated geological slide-scanning equipment in accordance with approved procedures. Select appropriate scanning settings based on slide characteristics and project requirements. Inspect, clean, handle, label, track, and scan petrographic thin-section slides. Maintain accurate slide manifests and scanning records. Review scanned images and identify imaging or quality-related issues. Perform rescanning when images do not meet the required quality standards. Monitor equipment performance and report operational issues promptly. Maintain an organized and traceable workflow for all assigned slides. Follow project procedures relating to quality control, HSE, confidentiality, and data security. Coordinate with the Project Manager and relevant laboratory personnel to meet schedules. Required Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Geology, Geoscience, Petrography, Microscopy, Laboratory or a related scientific or technical discipline Minimum 3 years of experience operating equipment similar to automated geological slide scanners. Demonstrated ability to inspect, clean, handle, track, and scan petrographic thin-section slides. Ability to identify imaging issues and perform accurate rescanning. Experience maintaining slide manifests, scanning logs, and related operational records. Experience with ZEISS AxioScan 7 or later versions is preferred. Experience working with geological, petrographic, biological, medical, or laboratory microscopy is considered a plus. Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. Ability to work onsite and follow established laboratory procedures. Good organizational and communication skills. Willing to relocate if required. Expected to be onsite for at least 75% of total working hours.

3a53f3ae8872a409.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قسمة السعودية للصيانة عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد برامج الصيانة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة تنفيذها. معرفة قوية بشبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وبرامج تشغيل المعدات. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال وإجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة قسمة السعودية للصيانة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلبات التوظيف. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

3a6bce738ff0b284.description: About AstraZeneca AstraZeneca is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines for serious diseases. The company is undergoing a significant transformation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, driven by a commitment to advancing healthcare and innovation. This evolution aims to better serve patients, collaborate with healthcare stakeholders, and contribute to the Saudi Vision 2030. About the Role AstraZeneca is seeking a Regulatory Affairs Senior Manager to join the Regional Regulatory Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the operational execution of Life Cycle Management (LCM) activities for assigned products across designated markets. The position requires senior regulatory expertise, technical and CMC judgment, and matrix leadership to drive efficient operating models and reduce operational burdens on local teams while maintaining market accountability. Key Responsibilities Lead the regional Life Cycle Management portfolio, ensuring alignment with business priorities, service levels, and compliance. Manage intake, prioritization, work allocation, capacity visibility, and governance of activities from Marketing Company teams. Lead complex activities related to dossier customization, regulatory submissions, national requirements, post-approval pathways, and CMC change management. Oversee the preparation, compilation, and quality review of country-ready regulatory packages, including Module 1, national forms, and administrative documentation. Execute or support regulatory submissions, maintain submission evidence, and ensure regulatory records are complete and current. Coordinate responses to health authority questions, ensuring timely submission and appropriate stakeholder involvement. Oversee approval follow-up activities, implementation of variations, regulatory system updates, and compliant activity closure. Lead regional capabilities for labeling adaptation and implementation, utilizing appropriate tools and quality controls. Design and enhance processes, templates, and workflows to improve efficiency and quality. Identify and manage regulatory, CMC, supply, quality, resource, and timeline risks, recommending mitigation measures. Lead the investigation and resolution of portal rejections, administrative non-compliance, and schedule deviations. Manage performance indicators related to workload volume, timeliness, quality, and response times. Provide matrix leadership, coaching, knowledge transfer, and specialized expertise within the team. Build strong relationships with Regulatory leaders and partners across various functions. Ensure activities comply with Good Regulatory Practice (GRP), AstraZeneca policies, GxP requirements, and the Code of Ethics. Qualifications and Requirements University degree or equivalent professional qualification in Pharmacy, Science, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum of 7 years of extensive experience in regulatory affairs for biopharmaceutical products, with significant responsibility for Life Cycle Management, national submissions, labeling, and regulatory CMC activities. Experience working across multiple markets, products, and national regulatory requirements within a regional or international environment. Strong understanding of post-approval regulatory frameworks, national dossier requirements, health authority procedures, CMC change management, and implementation controls. Demonstrated experience leading complex regulatory portfolios and cross-functional matrix teams. Ability to collaborate, influence, negotiate, and align local, regional, and global teams, as well as technical and functional partners. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to present technical information, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ability to make operational decisions, set priorities, and manage complex or ambiguous situations with a high degree of autonomy. Ability to evaluate technical and regulatory information, identify gaps, and provide practical, evidence-based recommendations. Experience using regulatory information systems, records management tools, submission tracking systems, and regulatory data maintenance processes. Desirable Capabilities Experience leading Centres of Excellence, regional hubs, shared services models, or transformation programs. Experience with Veeva RIM, ERV, or other regulatory planning, analytics, and management platforms. Experience implementing automation, digital workflows, dashboards, or continuous improvement solutions. Experience working with small molecules, biologics, or biotechnology-derived products. Experience partnering with Manufacturing, Supply, Quality, Labelling, and other functions involved in post-approval change implementation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a dynamic environment focused on advancing healthcare in KSA, requiring professionals who can thrive amidst change and contribute to shaping the future of healthcare.
